Camlorn.position: A city three days coach-north of Larenne, beyond Stanchgate, where the Bay Road gives out into a proper High Rock seat of stone and old Direnni lineage.

connections.path: south toward Stanchgate and Larenne, three days

Camlorn.description: Grey Direnni-cut stone under a colder sky than Larenne ever sees, a city old enough that half its cellars are older than its street plan. The Chapterhouse of the Eight sits on high ground near the old wall -- cloister, scriptorium, infirmary, and beneath it all a crypt the clergy do not discuss with wards who have not yet earned the asking.
